children: Mondelez International reported third-quarter 2026 revenue of $9.97B, up 2.3% from the prior-year quarter. Net income rose to $1.31B from $743M, while diluted EPS increased to $1.02 from $0.57.
¹ Reported as “Net revenues”. ² Reported as “Net earnings attributable to Mondelēz International”. ³ Reported as “Diluted earnings per share attributable to Mondelēz International”.
Third-quarter organic revenue grew 2.1%, while nine-month organic growth was 2.4%, supported by pricing and volume/mix.
Revenue increased in Latin America and AMEA. Europe declined 3.3% amid pricing pressure, while North America grew 1.1%.
Pricing actions supported revenue but contributed to higher consumer elasticity, particularly in Europe and Latin America. Management expects continued market volatility.
Volume/mix gains across most regions and categories supported organic growth; cocoa and other input costs remain near- and medium-term risks.
North America and Latin America completed the first phase of the global system rollout, with remaining segments targeted for completion by year-end 2028.
